contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Replace every nonoverlapping literal search with opening + search + closing. Preserve the matched text itself. All inserted text is literal and is not rescanned.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Search is nonempty.
contract.outputRole: source with each nonoverlapping match decorated
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
